title: EXP-021-R2 — Clean Replay: Static Caption Recovery Across Ordinary Close/Reopen
objective: In a fresh OpenCode/worker context, independently replay the accepted EXP-021 procedure on a new User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_StaticCaptionLab02`. Prove UI-level target absence on a live Select Form Name-filter surface with a positive control; create the Form through the replay-verified fresh-dialog/basic-form path; create and name one visibly verified Static component `FX_StaticCaptionStaticReplay`; then capture the AC-3 pre-Caption baseline, including Caption, No Colon, Name, and the available comparison properties. Component creation and naming are deliberate setup mutations before this baseline. After AC-3 is captured, set Caption to exactly `Static Caption Close Only Replay` as the only recorded deliberate target-property mutation; perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save to clean; close the target once through its ordinary Form-tab close control; reopen it once through Designer Form-menu recent forms in the same Designer/client context; and verify matching scoped Form/component state, exact Caption property value, No Colon, comparison properties, clean state, and rendered Static text. This replay tests only repeatability at the same weak close-only boundary and makes no Forms-database, cache-eviction, object-instance, or stronger lifecycle claim.

acceptance_checks.description: Before target mutation, record that EXP-021-R2 is running in a fresh OpenCode/worker context distinct from EXP-021 while the existing Designer/browser client context is retained for the product-boundary test. Also prove a usable live workflow, User editing scope, and UI-level absence of `FX_StaticCaptionLab02` on the live Select Form Name-filter surface in case-insensitive mode with a visible positive control. If one pre-mutation session establishment is required, disclose it and re-prove the live/scope/absence guards afterward. If fresh worker context cannot be established or recorded, the run is not eligible for replay_verified promotion.

Create one new User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_StaticCaptionLab02` through the verified fresh-dialog/basic-form path with Save Template unchecked; capture the success/loaded-clean state and visible Form identity/scope.

Perform one Static creation operation, deliberately name the component `FX_StaticCaptionStaticReplay`, and visibly verify its presence. After all component creation/naming setup is complete and before changing Caption, capture the pre-Caption baseline explicitly recording Caption, No Colon, component Name, and the other comparison properties exposed by the verified component workflow. Component creation and Name assignment are deliberate mutations that occur before this baseline; do not infer complete component inventory unless independently visible.

After the AC-3 pre-Caption baseline has been captured, set the target Static's Caption property to exactly `Static Caption Close Only Replay` and make no other deliberate target-property mutation thereafter. Capture the exact Caption property value, unchanged No Colon value, unchanged recorded comparison properties, and expected dirty state; label accessibility/property-grid evidence separately from rendered-visible text.

Perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save after the Caption edit and prove the Designer returns clean while the target Static remains present with exact Caption property value `Static Caption Close Only Replay`, the AC-3 No Colon value, and all recorded post-baseline comparison properties unchanged.

Close `FX_StaticCaptionLab02` exactly once through its ordinary Form-tab close control. Prove the target tab is closed, no unsaved-change or unexpected prompt occurred, and no explicit unload, reload, Regenerate, preference change, Designer replacement, or post-mutation session-establishment action occurred.

Reopen the target exactly once through the Designer Form-menu recent-forms path in the same Designer/client context and visibly verify the matching User-scoped Form identity using Name + ScopeType + ScopeName.

After reopen, verify component `FX_StaticCaptionStaticReplay` is present with exact Caption property value `Static Caption Close Only Replay`, the same No Colon value recorded at AC-3, and every recorded non-Caption comparison property equal to the AC-3 baseline. Capture rendered canvas text as corroborating display evidence only and keep it distinct from the exact Caption property value; do not infer internal object-instance identity or complete component cardinality.

Final read-only audit must reconcile: fresh OpenCode/worker context for this replay; exactly one ordinary Save; one target Form-tab close; one recent-forms reopen; no deliberate target-property mutation after AC-3 except Caption; zero explicit unloads, Regenerates, preference changes, Designer replacements, or post-mutation authentication actions; and repository changes confined to the EXP-021-R2 record plus `evidence/EXP-021-R2/`. If a live final inventory read is attempted, any Session Expired or recovery-obstructed result is invalid evidence and must block that criterion rather than trigger recovery.
